name: EDUSPEC
recent: EDUSPEC 近期有多项 Warrant C 转换为普通股的公告，新股陆续上市。同时，公司 CEO Dato' Sri Gan Chow Tee 在公开市场多次增持股份。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日的季度报告。
notable: Warrant C 转换为普通股，涉及多次新股发行，发行价为每股 RM0.03。
CEO Dato' Sri Gan Chow Tee 在 2026 年 11 月多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
公司发布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日的季度报告。
risks: Warrant C 持续转换导致股本逐步扩大，可能摊薄现有股东权益。

recent_en: EDUSPEC has made several announcements on the conversion of Warrant C into ordinary shares, with new shares listed progressively. Meanwhile, CEO Dato' Sri Gan Chow Tee has acquired shares in the open market multiple times. The company also released its quarterly report for the period ended 31 August 2026.
notable_en: Conversion of Warrant C into ordinary shares, involving multiple new share issuances at RM0.03 per share.
CEO Dato' Sri Gan Chow Tee acquired shares in the open market multiple times in November 2026.
The company released its quarterly report for the period ended 31 August 2026.
risks_en: The ongoing conversion of Warrant C gradually enlarges the share base, potentially diluting existing shareholders' equity.
